title: Volume 2 Chapter 3: Howling for You Who Cannot Cry 3
content: Shara grabbed my shoulders from behind and shook me back and forth to make her presence known.
She didn’t let it slide, huh?
I'm really sorry!
Just a moment ago, that thing was a human with blonde hair, wearing a mask to hide its face, and about the same height as you, Shara!
By the way, both Shara's magical power and that masked thing's magical power were quite ordinary, so I couldn't tell them apart.
Erika's unique magical power was actually the rare one.
"There’s no way a human could turn into a demon! What do you think? Do I look goat-like to you!?"
This girl really only had eyes for me, huh?
I realized this unpleasant truth while feeling exasperated about whether I looked goat-like or not.
But she was genuinely angry at me.
"No, Shara. That thing was really a human just a moment ago."
Erika gently peeled Shara's hands off my shoulders.
"Even you, Erika... Is that really true?"
She would believe Erika's words in an instant.
"Yes, it is. But I'm sorry, I thought that thing was you too."
Erika apologized to Shara.
"Given my circumstances, I couldn't help it."
Shara didn’t ask what those circumstances were, likely because she recognized the sincerity in Erika's voice.
However, that’s just an excuse.
If I had been calm, I should have realized it.
That thing was too big in the chest to be you.
Shara let out a soundless scream, "Kuh!" at Erika's words, which were filled with sincere regret.
Well, I guess I was in the wrong here.
Once this situation calmed down, I would sincerely apologize for everything.
Thinking that, I suddenly shouted.
"Erika!"
At my words, Erika immediately reacted, and I realized it wasn’t necessary for me to warn her.
By the time I called Erika's name, she was already in a position to leap back while holding Shara to her side.
Erika's golden magical power indicated where she intended to jump, so I followed her lead.
Just then, the ground exploded.
Tentacles that had somehow multiplied to four were gouging into the earth.
The Goat Demon Tribe hadn’t moved from the spot near the remnants of the former Great Demon Knight's magic stone.
Those tentacles were quite long, I thought, while also realizing that this creature had some form of intelligence, just like the horse demons.
That’s why it was wary of us.
The fact that it extended its tentacles to keep its distance while attacking, and took time to strike despite exposing itself so much, was due to its caution.
Well, that was only natural.
If it had any intelligence at all, it couldn’t help but be wary of Erika's strength, who had defeated the Great Demon Knight.
As soon as I landed, I lowered my stance and readied myself to move at any moment.
I noticed Erika gently setting Shara down on the ground behind me.
Facing an unknown enemy that likely hadn’t shown all its strength, I felt no fear whatsoever.
Erika was behind me.
It was a different kind of reassurance than when my master watched over me from behind; just having her by my side made something inside me swell with excitement, and I couldn’t help but smile.
This was what it felt like to be confident in victory.
"Shin."
Erika's voice, calling out to me from behind, solidified that confidence.
It was hard for me to imagine a future where I would lose to that thing while fighting alongside Erika.
"Then I’ll leave the rest to you."
...Huh?
I unintentionally glanced away from the Goat Demon Tribe to look at Erika.
She had a dazzling smile on her face, and I also caught a glimpse of Shara, who was seriously checking her own chest.
That smile was reminiscent of the time the prince of Faltarl tried to push himself into the outing planned with Erika and the Light Priestess, and she had firmly rejected him.
This smile meant that she was saying,
"I’m counting on you,
" which likely meant Erika was angry and wanted me to take responsibility...
I pointed at the Goat Demon Tribe, then at myself, just to test the waters.
Erika nodded with a smile that seemed to say "Well done."
Shara, placing her hand on her chest with a serious expression, how could she be so concerned about that when a demon was right in front of her?
"What about the marriage vow?"
I turned my gaze back to the Goat Demon Tribe and asked, even though I felt it was a bad idea.
"Right now, we are adventurers."
What did that mean?
Wait, does that mean we’re not married?
A cold sweat broke out all over my body.
No way... Does this mean divorce?
Calm down! Calm down, me!
I desperately called out to my heart, which was instinctively looking for a cliff to jump off.
It was originally a one-year promise; it had just been expedited.
This was a conversation that would come someday, so it wasn’t something to despair over, right?
...No, I should just die.
Since Erika told me to take care of that thing, I would kill the Goat Demon Tribe and then die, yes, die.
"Well, if an arm or a leg gets blown off, then we can revisit the marriage vow."
So, if I lose an arm or a leg, I can avoid divorce?
Surely, Erika didn’t mean that if I lost an arm or a leg, she would come to my aid or something like that.
In other words, if I lost an arm or a leg, she would forgive me, how kind of her.
Erika, you’re so kind, I like you.
I thought about how it would be fine if it were just my left arm, since she said an arm, it would be from the shoulder, and as I was considering this, Erika continued.
"A human claiming to be my husband getting injured by a slightly larger hairless goat is a bit of a worry, I suppose."
Alright, I’m unscathed.
I’ll take that thing’s head without a scratch.
"My disciple is quite the thorough efficiency-oriented type."
My master,
"Kind Barbara,
" spoke to me while I held a magical tool that increased in weight the longer I held it, and I had no idea what it was for.
Apparently, it was used in civil engineering.
Having held it for about an hour, I was already nearing my limit and could barely nod.
"No, I’m talking about the use of magic, my disciple."
Did my gaze carry a hint of confusion? My master answered.
You have an ordinary amount of magical power, so it’s only natural that you’d try to make up for it with strength, output, and duration.
Wishing for the magical tool to consume its magic stones and free me from this weight, I was still puzzled about what my master was trying to say.
My kind master probably thought I would get bored with just training body enhancement magic, so she decided to throw in some theory as well.
But I couldn’t focus at all.
If you ignore the duration and want to quickly increase strength and output, you should increase the magical power you put into the magic circle.
That’s what my master meant by increasing pressure.
But doing that would quickly reach the magic circle's limit. The magic circle wouldn’t hold.
"That’s right, disciple."
My master picked up on my unspoken question as if it were obvious.
Simply increasing the magical power in the magic circle will quickly reach its limit.
So what do you do?
You increase the strength of the magic circle.
Wait, hold on, what does my master plan to do? What’s that magic stone she’s holding?
I was so weighed down that I could barely tell if the weight was increasing, but I desperately continued to enhance my body.
There are mainly two ways to increase the strength of a magic circle.
One is to increase the magical power used to construct the magic circle.
That’s the method of a genius.
If you have just a bit more magical power than average, you probably won’t even be able to construct a magic circle properly.
The master with the magic stone approached me.
The other method is simple.
You just need to train the body that will construct the magic circle.
A well-trained body increases the strength of the magic circle.
In other words, disciple, you need to train your body.
So she was going to give me an extra magic stone, my master added more magic stones to the magical tool.
Her face was genuinely satisfied with her kindness, and it seemed she was about to say, "Look, I’m kind, aren’t I?"
That kindness is impossible right now!
I desperately tried to squeeze out the dwindling magical power, but I felt like I could see my arms getting crushed in just a few minutes.
Meanwhile, my master said,
"You could also increase the amount of magical power flowing into the magic circle, but that’s also a genius's method.
It’s surprisingly inefficient,
" but I had no energy left to think.
We adventurers have a rough understanding of handling magical power.
When we say
"putting magical power into the magic circle,
" we’re not sure if it means the amount of magical power flowing into the magic circle or increasing the pressure of the magical power.
Mostly, we adventurers use the term "put in" casually based on the situation.
That’s because we don’t learn magic systematically like the nobles who attend the academy.
Well, in my case, I was too lackadaisical as a student.
I’m not bragging, but I’m confident I spent more time looking at Erika than at the blackboard.
"Now, I have a question for you, Goat Demon Tribe."
My inner voice, recalling my master’s teachings, couldn’t possibly be heard.
I sensed confusion on the Goat Demon Tribe’s face, not knowing what "now" meant.
Slowly, deliberately approaching, I continued.
Unlike you guys, with my ordinary magical power, if I were to try to increase the strength of my body enhancement right now, what would I do?
The magical lines of power licked over my body as the Goat Demon Tribe’s gaze followed mine.
It was clear it was debating between using tentacles or magic.
I stopped my feet at a distance where both options were viable.
I was still only using ordinary body enhancement.
"Just a moment ago..."
I ignored the rising feeling of aversion and discomfort that surged from my gut with each word.
This wasn’t Shara; normal
"murderous intent
" was enough.
When I was fighting the Oganite, I realized something.
I don’t have the magical power to construct a solid magic circle.
I don’t have the amount of magical power to flow into the magic circle, and my body isn’t suddenly going to become strong enough to make the magic circle solid.
This was "Kind Barbara’s" lesson on combat.
If you can’t take the initiative, disrupt your opponent’s timing as much as possible.
Then it hit me.
Wait a minute, I can use body enhancement on my armor too?
The clothes I enhanced with body enhancement were fine while my arms were getting crushed.
Having intelligence can be a burden, I thought, as I made the Goat Demon Tribe listen to my pointless rambling.
Every time the Goat Demon Tribe’s gaze strayed behind me, I moved my body to obstruct it.
Was it that interesting to them that Erika was behind me?
Then, if body enhancement can be applied to clothing, that means it’s my body too, right?
A sturdy body, sturdier than my own body, right?
So, in this way...
Before I could finish that thought, the ground beneath my feet exploded.
A strike from the tentacles, faster and more ferocious than the previous long-range attack, gouged into the ground.
But the explosion was mostly my fault.
As an inexperienced adventurer who had just begun to use body enhancement, I had dramatically dug into the ground.
Even the Goat Demon Tribe's face showed surprise. I thought about how desperately it was tracking my movements.
"Why must I suffer like this? It’s unreasonable!"
The Goat Demon Tribe spat curses in a voice that sounded like it was forcibly moving a throat that shouldn’t be able to produce human speech.
I couldn’t tell if the fear or resentment reflected in the demon's unreadable eyes was genuine.
"This monster!"
I had no reason to be called a monster by a former human who had turned into a demon, so I severed the demon's head along with the arms that were shielding it.
Thus, I successfully avoided divorce with Erika.
After confirming that my face wasn’t twitching as I looked down, I declared with all my might, silently.
I managed to avoid it, right?
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5IlPb0G.jpeg
Please say I did!
I’m unscathed, right?
If that’s not enough, I’m willing to offer an arm or a leg, can we work something out, Erika?
I cautiously raised my gaze.

As I lightly jumped to behead the Goat Demon Tribe, I gained too much momentum and ended up soaring over Erika and the others, using a tree behind me as a foothold to return with a foolish triangle jump.
I swore to myself never to do anything foolish on a whim again as I released the second magic circle I had constructed on my back.
The shirt woven from the thread obtained from a minor monster called Black Something finally felt like it had returned to being an ordinary shirt.
By the way, despite its name, the thread was white.
Honestly, that didn’t matter at all.
Having released the double body enhancement, my thoughts settled, and I quietly exhaled.
The sense of time can get quite distorted during high-intensity body enhancement.
My body moves before my thoughts, and I feel a mix of past and present.
This time was a bit worse than usual, but thanks to that, I was able to accomplish my goal.
Erika’s whim was to defeat the Goat Demon Tribe without a scratch if I wanted to avoid divorce.
I was unscathed, so I should have been able to avoid it safely.
But I knew.
Women sometimes have a habit of asking for seconds on their whims.
Even a socially awkward guy like me knows that after the event, they might reveal what they really wanted.
I wouldn’t call it a last-minute whim; it was the fault of the man who couldn’t pick up on the hints.
So, if Erika said something like,
"The angle at which the Goat Demon Tribe's head fell was bad,
" I was prepared to offer an arm or a leg.
So, could we please avoid divorce?
I wouldn’t even mind living with one less limb without using healing magic.
As long as I could be with you, it would be a small price to pay.
I raised my face, hoping that this would allow me to avoid divorce.
If Erika had wrinkles on her brow, I would throw myself into a deep bow out of sheer momentum.
Maybe kind Erika would forgive me in a moment of impulse.
At the very least, I hoped she wouldn’t have a face that said,
"Well, you did okay,
" as I raised my gaze, only to find an unexpected smile from Erika.
What is this...? I turned over the collection of smiles I had observed from Erika during our time at the academy.
This smile of Erika’s, what does it mean?
It’s definitely not the smile she had when crushing a cunning noble, but it’s not in my collection either.
The closest one is... that’s right, that smile.
The one she had when the Light Priestess scored better than her for the first time on a test.
That’s the closest.
So, does this mean I’m forgiven? Did I pass?
Is everything okay? Am I forgiven?
Honestly, I didn’t know what kind of face I should make, and when I smiled back...
Erika deepened her smile. What should I do? I might just fall in love, oh wait, I already have.
"You moved splendidly."
I was relieved by Erika’s smile, but then I was struck with dread when she said she had seen all of my movements, which I couldn’t even control.
I recalled her battles up to this point.
Surely, she had only just begun to unleash her full potential after leaving the academy, and now she was still getting used to her own strength.
From here on out, she would only grow stronger.
I didn’t know if she was aware of that, but Erika Solnzali had the ability to accomplish that without any guidance.
I trembled at the difficulty of standing beside her.
"What do you think? Will I get a passing score?"
So I said it lightly.
If I could give up on myself due to my ordinariness, I would have done so long ago.
Even if I trembled in fear of that difference, it was literally too late for that.
"Well, let’s see."
Erika pondered while wrapping a strand of her red hair around her right index finger.
"That... was wonderful."
Yes! Divorce avoided! I silently cheered inside.
In other words, it was a simple matter.
She was a genius.
The fact that she could brush off my fear of the overwhelming strength of body enhancement with just a word of praise revealed her depth.
How much absurdity would I have to go through to continue standing beside her?
I didn’t have to fear that question, but I still wavered a bit. Perhaps it was the relief of having avoided divorce.
I became anxious about whether I was worthy to stand beside her.
"One more word."
The wavering heart greedily sought words to motivate itself.
Specifically, I wanted Erika to praise me. If I could, I wanted her to pat my head. If that happened, I would die.
"One more word... is it?"
Erika looked at me with a puzzled expression.
If she had been exasperated with me here, I would have lost my confidence, but Erika lowered her eyes and seriously considered.
She softly murmured, "Hmm," as she thoughtfully searched for words, and it was incredibly cute.
Specifically, the way she held her index finger, still wrapped in hair, to her chin while thinking was the best.
Erika glanced at my face, then gently averted her gaze as she responded to my request.
Well, it was interesting that you tried to gauge the opponent's intelligence by speaking to them first.
I didn’t quite understand it, but it seemed like you could read their expressions.
Perhaps that’s a difference in experience as an adventurer?
Also, while you were speaking, you subtly positioned yourself between us and the enemy, blocking the shortest route while maintaining eye contact.
That was very considerate.
The one word I desired turned into an unexpectedly long response.
Once she started talking, it seemed she got into the groove, or perhaps she simply found it enjoyable to reflect on the combat, as Erika's voice began to bounce.
"And the body enhancement was remarkable."
She closed her eyes, recalling the memory.
I never expected you to have such a hidden talent.
Is that a secret technique of the Longdagger family?
That speed was extraordinary.
I witnessed a speed that made me feel like it was the first time in my life that I had seen something blur.
That kind of speed, you could count them on one hand across the entire country.
My throat warmed at Erika's straightforward praise.
I recalled the first time my master praised me.
That must be why.
When I answered Erika that it wasn’t a secret technique of the Longdagger family but something I just thought of, my voice trembled.
I couldn’t argue if she told me not to try ideas in actual combat.
"Is that so? If that’s the case, it’s even more impressive."
Erika’s voice was filled with excitement.
To suddenly think of something and then bring it to fruition, how much effort and training must have been behind that?
Please, I can’t take any more.
I covered my face with both hands, feeling my cheeks flush.
As I turned red and looked down, for some reason, Erika’s voice became even more lively.
She spoke of that speed.
She spoke of that sharpness of my sword.
She said, "My husband is..."
Stop! I’m going to die; I’m really going to die.
Erika’s voice grew even more animated, and she praised even my footwork and posture, leaving me at a loss for what to do.
Suddenly, the calm part of me popped up, reminding me that this wasn’t the time to be doing this in the Demon Realm's middle layer.
But when Erika praised the line of my neck when viewed from the side, I quickly retreated.
I thought this had nothing to do with the earlier battle, but I couldn’t bring myself to say, "That’s enough."
I wouldn’t even mind staying like this forever.
I half-seriously thought that, but Shara’s exasperated voice wouldn’t allow it.
"I don’t know what kind of ritual this is, but can you both return to your senses?"
When I looked up, I met Shara’s exasperated gaze.
What’s going on?
I thought I was suddenly punched by Shin and desperately returned, only to be mistaken for a disgusting goat, and now you’re bragging about it?
Also, I really want Shin to explain later why I resemble a goat.
Shara sighed, mixed with some sort of theatrical relief, and for some reason, Erika covered her face and muttered,
"I’ve done it now.
If Erika gets embarrassed here, it’ll be back to square one, so please bear with it.
Besides, praising your husband isn’t something to be embarrassed about, is it?
Though it was exhausting to hear, Shara bluntly dismissed Erika.
I see, Erika was embarrassed because she praised me too much.
I thought it was due to the tension easing after the battle, but if that praise was genuine, even just a tenth of it, I would be happy.
I felt ashamed of myself for forgetting that Erika was a former marquis daughter, focusing only on her strength.
It was entirely predictable that Erika, having been raised as a noble daughter, would say things she didn’t mean in a heightened state of excitement after a battle, even if she wasn’t used to it yet.
That meant I had provoked her by asking for one more word.
Because of that, I had embarrassed Erika.
I truly hated my own weakness.
"I don’t quite understand why Shin looks troubled when Erika gets embarrassed, but can you listen to me?"
Shara looked at us with a gaze that seemed to say, "What is this couple?"
In the strange post-battle tension, I was being praised by Erika, and Shara was witnessing my embarrassment, leaving me speechless.
Shara pointed.
"I’m not very knowledgeable about monsters, let alone demons, but..."
Her gaze led to the dead Goat Demon Tribe lying there.
"Is that what a dead demon looks like?"
